SOURCE CONTEXT: واحد من العملاء دخل مكتبي وهو في حالة غضب شديد، بيحكي لي إنه رفع دعوى تعويض ضد شركة تسببت في خسائر فادحة لمشروعه، ولما سألته عن تفاصيل الصفة في الدعوى، اتضح إنه رفعها باسمه الشخصي مش باسم الشركة اللي هي صاحبة الحق الأصلي في التعويض، الموقف ده بيحصل كتير وبيكون نتيجته رفض الدعوى لعدم قبولها لانتفاء الصفة، لأن القانون بيفرق بدقة بين الشخص الطبيعي والشخص الاعتباري، والخلط بينهم بيضيع حقوق كاملة، قبل ما تاخد خطوة قضائية في دعوى تعويض، لازم تتأكد من 3 علامات تحذيرية: أولاً، هل الضرر أصاب ذمتك المالية الشخصية ولا أصاب ذمة الشركة؟ لو الشركة هي اللي اتضررت، لازم الدعوى تترفع باسمها وبواسطة ممثلها القانو

He clutches a thin stack of papers in his left hand, the top sheet slightly fluttering. Across the desk, a seated professional in a blazer leans slightly forward, one hand resting on an open laptop keyboard, the other poised to take notes, his expression attentive but composed. On the desk, clearly visible are: an open laptop displaying a blank screen, a ceramic coffee mug, a neutral‑colored folder (no visible label), a small stack of official‑looking documents – one appears to be a company registration certificate, another a power‑of‑attorney form, and a personal identification card placed beside them – all without readable text. The composition is captured from a slight over‑the‑shoulder angle of the seated professional, focusing on the angry client and the spread of documents, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the desk items sharply in focus. Soft ceiling lighting adds gentle fill, creating subtle shadows that highlight the tension in the scene. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A professional, high-quality, realistic cinematic office scene: A middle-aged man in a button-down shirt stands at a sleek glass desk in a bright, sunlit office, looking frustrated and tense while holding a stack of legal papers. Across from him, a lawyer in a blazer sits at the desk, leaning forward with an attentive and composed expression, preparing to take notes. On the desk, there is an open laptop, a coffee mug, and a clear, organized pile of realistic legal documents including a company registration form and an ID card. Shallow depth of field, soft natural lighting, professional legal setting. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
